questions.q: Why does the summary say interruptive ads like TV spots and direct mail fail?
a: People care about themselves, not your product details
They cost more than any content ever could
They reach audiences that are too narrow
They are banned in most large markets
questions.why: Lesson 1 says customers care about themselves and how you improve their lives.

questions.q: What does Deere and Company's Furrow publication do?
a: Solves customer problems while promoting its products
Mails discount catalogs to loyal farmers
Runs television spots during weather reports
Sponsors a racing team to build awareness
questions.why: Lesson 1 describes articles that help customers and promote the brand.

questions.q: What is a customer persona supposed to describe?
a: The traits and needs of your ideal customer
The prices your competitors charge
The keywords with the highest search volume
The posting schedule for each platform
questions.why: Lesson 2 says personas identify who your customer is and what they need.

questions.q: Under the 4-1-1 technique, how should six shares be divided?
a: Four influencer pieces, one of yours, one marketing item
Four marketing items, one influencer piece, one of yours
Three of yours, two influencer pieces, one marketing item
Two influencer pieces, two marketing items, two of yours
questions.why: Lesson 3 credits Andrew Davis with the 4-1-1 split for social sharing.

questions.q: Why can a niche site beat a huge platform for content marketing?
a: It has a smaller audience but easier access to interested people
It ranks automatically on the first page of search
It requires no publishing plan or schedule
It charges less for advertising space
questions.why: Lesson 3 says niche sites are easier for the right people to find.
